title: microcharts catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of every microcharts chart: import paths, data shape, primary encoding, and props. Full API for a chart = sharedProps + charts[n].props; interactive shared callbacks apply only when listed in charts[n].sharedInteractive. See top-level howToRead. Generated from the chart registry; served at /catalog.json.

howToRead.description: Instructions for assembling a chart's full prop surface from sharedProps, props, and sharedInteractive.

sharedProps.description: Props whose name means the same thing wherever they appear — grammar, layout, i18n, and shared interactive props. Interactive names in this list apply to a chart ONLY when also listed in that chart's sharedInteractive.

name.description: Prop name as written in JSX. A `/` joins a documented pair (e.g. `xLabel / yLabel`).

required.description: Whether the prop must be passed.

description.description: One-line human description of the prop.

interactive.description: Present and `true` only when the prop exists on the `…/interactive` entry alone (the static default component does not accept it).

status.description: `stable` ships today; `planned` is catalogued but not yet released.

docs.description: Absolute URL of the chart's documentation page.

staticImport.description: Import path of the static, RSC-safe default entry.

interactiveImport.description: Import path of the `…/interactive` client entry, when the chart has one.

picker.description: Present on interactive charts. `true` ⇒ multi-unit picker contract (onActive / onSelect / selectedIndex / defaultSelectedIndex). `false` ⇒ no roving picker (lean scalars, MinimapStrip, TokenConfidence).

animates.description: Present on interactive charts. `true` ⇒ accepts shared `animate` (requires `@microcharts/react/motion`). `false` ⇒ no entrance motion prop.

sharedInteractive.description: Exact shared interactive prop names this chart's `/interactive` entry accepts (subset of sharedProps). Empty array ⇒ interactive entry exists but takes none of the shared interactive props. Omit the field when there is no interactive entry.

dataShape.description: The shape of the `data` prop, as source text.

primaryEncoding.description: The one documented primary encoding channel.

bestFor.description: Situations this chart is the right pick for.

avoidFor.description: Situations to reach for a different chart instead.

props.description: Chart-specific props only. Combine with sharedProps; apply shared interactive names only when listed in sharedInteractive. Chart-specific callbacks (e.g. onWindowChange) appear here with interactive:true.
